background: Kingdom 5th Season adapts chapters 442-489 of the original manga.

node.title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Kaikou

episodes_data.title: Monsters Take the Field
episodes_data.description: The Fei Xin Force is sent out to join forces with General Huan Yi to conquer Heiyong in Zhao, but their opponent--and the terrain--won`t make it easy.

episodes_data.title: The Stench of the Battlefield
episodes_data.title_es: El hedor del campo de batalla
episodes_data.description: As the fighting gets underway in Heiyong, Qiang Lei`s scouts make a disturbing discovery, Xin goes for broke, and Huan Yi brings out the big guns.

episodes_data.title: A Lieutenant's Responsibility
episodes_data.description: Tactician He Liao Diao racks her brains to find some way out of an impossible situation so the Fei Xin Force can complete their mission-critical task.

episodes_data.title: A Determined Crossing
episodes_data.description: Lieutenant Yuan and his men work hard to fulfill their vital role. A surprise appearance by a charismatic figure greatly affects the tides of battle.

episodes_data.title: Heiyong's Crucial Moment
episodes_data.description: He Liao Diao switches gears to share some hard-earned power with Huan Yi`s forces--all the general has to do is take it. Qiang Lei`s caretaker speaks.

episodes_data.title: The Tragedy of Liyan
episodes_data.description: Qiang Lei learns about Ji Hui`s background. Frustration mounts in the face of Huan Yi`s inaction. Qing She decides to take matters into his own hands.

episodes_data.title: In an Instant
episodes_data.description: The Battle of Heiyong reaches a fever pitch as Huan Yi`s men target Qing She--who in turn is looking to slay Xin. Xin comes up with an audacious plan.

episodes_data.title: Misfortune
episodes_data.description: Qing She considers his debt to Li Mu as he faces Xin on the battlefield. Devastating events drive Ji Hui to pursue a new tactic in defending Heiyong.

episodes_data.title: Roar of Pride
episodes_data.description: Huan Yi`s top commanders question his latest bizarre decision. Wei Ping has a crisis of conscience. Xin and Qiang Lei react to a gruesome discovery.

episodes_data.title: Wei Ping and the Fei Xin Force
episodes_data.title_es: Wei Ping y la Fuerza Fei Xin
episodes_data.description: The standoff with Huan Yi continues until Wei Ping intervenes, but Xin learns a disappointing fact that paints his loyal friend in a whole new light.

episodes_data.title: The Small Hours Before a Showdown
episodes_data.title_es: Las pequeñas horas antes de un enfrentamiento
episodes_data.description: General Huan Yi shows that his cutthroat reputation is well deserved as he tightens the screws on Ji Hui and forces him to make an agonizing decision.

episodes_data.title: Cai Ze's Honor
episodes_data.description: Cai Ze returns to Xianyang with not one, but two unexpected guests. Zheng is put on the spot about his plans for a post-unified Middle Kingdom world.
